extracted.intended_audience: general readers, car enthusiasts, and researchers looking for information on the Shuanghuan Laibao vehicle
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia article describing the Shuanghuan Laibao (Laibao S-RV) midsize SUV: its specifications, production history, design origin, pricing, and the intellectual property dispute with Honda.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name and general overview
rubrics_metrics.description: The Shuanghuan Laibao (Chinese: 来宝) or Shuanghuan Laibao S-RV is a midsize SUV with the design inspired by the Honda CR-V. It was manufactured by Shuanghuan from 2003 to 2010.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes primary identifying information: model name(s), class (midsize SUV), manufacturing years (2003–2010) and the assertion of design inspiration from the Honda CR-V. Also notes assembly location (Shijiazhuang, Hebei, China).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chassis derivation / lineage
rubrics_metrics.description: The chassis was based on the chassis of Shuanghuan Laiwang, which was designed based on the chassis of the fifth generation 1992 Toyota Hilux.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains technical lineage and platform derivation, useful for understanding mechanical underpinnings and heritage rather than styling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class, body style, and layout
rubrics_metrics.description: Class: Mid-size SUV. Body style: 5-door SUV. Layout: Front-engine, rear-wheel-drive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies vehicle category and basic packaging/layout characteristics that define its market segment and driving dynamics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engine options and power/torque figures
rubrics_metrics.description: Engine options include: EQ491i 2.0L petrol I4 producing 112 hp (84 kW) and 163 N⋅m (120 lbf⋅ft); JM491Q-ME 2.2L petrol I4 producing 103 hp (77 kW) and 193 N⋅m (142 lbf⋅ft); 4G63V16 2.4L petrol I4 producing 125 hp (93 kW) and 190 N⋅m (140 lbf⋅ft).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the available engine displacements and their rated horsepower and torque; these specs inform performance comparisons and buyer expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmission
rubrics_metrics.description: All engines are mated to a 5-speed manual gearbox.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies drivetrain gearing available for the model as presented on the page (manual-only).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dimensions (wheelbase, length, width, height)
rubrics_metrics.description: Wheelbase: 2,850 mm (112 in). Length: 4,600 mm (180 in). Width: 1,770 mm (70 in). Height: 1,720 mm (68 in).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives exterior dimensional metrics used to compare vehicle size, interior packaging potential, and parking/garage fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Price range (historical)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prices before discontinuation of the Laibao S-RV in 2004 ranged from 96,800 yuan to 115,800 yuan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical MSRP/price-band information useful for market positioning and historical comparisons; note this reflects the period before discontinuation in 2004.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design resemblance / controversy
rubrics_metrics.description: The design of the updated 2003 Shuanghuan Laibao S-RV is controversial as the midsize SUV heavily resembles the second generation Honda CR-V compact crossover.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flags styling controversy and public/industry perception of copying: an important non-technical attribute affecting reputation, sales, and legal risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intellectual property lawsuit and legal outcome
rubrics_metrics.description: Honda filed a lawsuit on November 13, 2003, alleging the Laibao violated Honda's intellectual property because it heavily resembles the second generation Honda CR-V. In March 2006, China's State Intellectual Property Office decided that Honda's patent for the CR-V design was invalid. In 2010, the Beijing People's High Court ruled that Shijazhuang Shuanghuan Automobile Co.'s Laibao infringed Honda's design patent; Shuanghuan was fined 16 million yuan (final claim was 45 million yuan).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a timeline of legal proceedings and conflicting decisions (SIPO invalidation in 2006 versus Beijing High Court finding of infringement in 2010) and financial penalties — relevant for legal, business, and IP-policy analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Predecessor model
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the immediately preceding model in the manufacturer's lineup, indicating continuity or evolution in model development.
